title: Disputes freshness check crashes when no inventory file is supplied

finding.claim: Disputes freshness check crashes when no inventory file is supplied
finding.evidence: The new --check path initializes inventory_ids to an empty set and only populates it inside the optional args.inventory branch, but then always calls the freshness checker with that set. If the checker expects the same optional contract as the non-span path, this changes behavior for the common '--check --span ...' case and can reject or mis-handle all open disputes instead of treating inventory a
finding.recommendation: Preserve the absence/presence distinction by using None when --inventory is not provided, and only pass a set when a file was actually loaded. Add a test for 'codereview disputes --check --span A..B' without --inventory.
